lead.title: Can an unmarried daughter claim maintenance from her father? Bombay high court answers
lead.summary: The Bombay high court has upheld a family court's order for a father to pay maintenance to his children. The father challenged the maintenance order, arguing his children were no longer entitled to payment. The court ruled his son was a minor when the original order was made, and his daughter's need for support was valid.
